en:
Shuichi...have you given some thought
to what we discussed before?
What we discussed before?
Regarding your hidden potential.
Ah, of course...

I assume you have not thought about it,
judging by your reaction.
...So you can tell, huh?

Maids require the ability to sense their
master's thoughts.
<CLT=cltMIND>A maid's abilities, huh?

It seems like you're prepared for anything,
Kirumi. But is that expected of you?

If I wish to fulfill all of my master's needs,
then of course.

Not only their needs, but there are times
when I must fight for my master's safety.
Fight? What do you mean?

It is exactly how I said it.
Although, it has not happened too often.
Not too often? What happened?

I served an owner of a conglomerate before.
His daughter was kidnapped by criminals.

Using his daughter, the criminal organization
asked for a ransom equaling the state budget.

The owner would have paid it. However, giving
so much money to criminals had to be avoided.

Fortunately, we knew where the criminals'
main base was located.

I had the owner prepare my weapons,
so that I may retrieve his daughter.
You mean, by yourself!?

Yes. The situation called for immediate
action.

Of course, if I had attacked them by
myself, I would not have survived.
The daughter's safety was my top priority.

Shuichi... If you were in this situation,
what kind of order would you execute?

Ah, well...you were familiar with the
location, so you should know the layout.

You could use that to your advantage,
splitting the enemy and engaging them.
Well done, Shuichi...

Yes, I separated the enemy forces and
neutralized them one by one.

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm honestly amazed... Sure, I can
think of it, but I could never actually do it.

I secured his daughter and reached the
organization's boss...
So, case closed then?

No, that was not enough. If I had left them as
is, they would have attempted to try again.
So, that is why...
<CLT=cltMIND>...Did she...kill them all?

I persuaded the criminal leader to start
a business.
A business?

I did not see as much potential in him
as I see in you, but he did have some.

I told him that if I served as his maid,
I would definitely make him successful.

He understood the situation quickly,
and considered my proposal.

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't know if "considered"
is the right word...

<CLT=cltMIND>He would never have turned down a
maid that could take out a whole group.

We are currently maintaining a
butler service industry.

Ah, butlers.
I see...

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm sure that they'll do just fine
if they're being taught by Kirumi.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kirumi is a supermaid...
with incredible service.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Kirumi's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kirumi and I parted ways,
and I returned to my room.
